definitions.explanation: The practice of saving money by avoiding unnecessary spending; being economical with resources.

examples.japanese: {倹約|けんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: To be mindful of saving money.

examples.japanese: {倹約|けんやく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: I saved money by being frugal and increased my savings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{倹約|けんやく}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{無駄遣|むだづか}い→無駄遣い：07310_mudazukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My mother is frugal and never wastes money.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倹約|けんやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to economize, to be frugal
- {倹約|けんやく}{家|か}: a thrifty person, a penny pincher
- {倹約|けんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧: to try to be economical
- {倹約|けんやく}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: frugal living

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧: saving, economizing — the everyday word, used of specific things (⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧); {倹約|けんやく} names a frugal way of life and sounds a little old-fashioned
- ⟦けち→けち：02792_kechi⟧: stingy — negative, while {倹約|けんやく} is a virtue
- ⟦{浪費|ろうひ}→浪費：09204_rouhi⟧: waste — the opposite
